overview: Pushkar Tours is a premium travel agency website for personalized, family-centric, and soulful travel experiences. Features a cinematic Leh snow hero, interactive destination guides, a searchable FAQ hub, a travel style quiz, and complete lead capture — all in a sober black & white minimalist design.
features: Travel Clarity Hub — searchable FAQ page with Domestic, International, and Spiritual categories
Journey Atlas — interactive guide to Indian states with how to reach, best season, cuisine, and tips
Design Your Journey — 3-step quiz that suggests a travel style and captures leads
Ken Burns Leh snow hero with cinematic overlay
Sticky WhatsApp button with quick-reply suggestions
Get Expert Advice modal with full lead capture form
Footer with policy links and all contact/social info
